verdict: Explicit GO for the ORIGINAL full fresh108-cell research design, including prospective model-to-external-outcome validation and clean runtime controls. This is not approval of a smaller diagnostic as the success criterion. Implementation/source/resource/phase-transfer qualification and the frozen actual protocol require separate review before any main dispatch; no result or capacity success is presumed.

original_criterion_and_hypothesis.criterion: Determine feasibility of actual eBPF observations for operation models and Bering-to-Sheaft forecasts with absent or incomplete SDK tracing, judged against independent external outcomes with equal semantic information and strongest reasonable simple baselines. No ML, mathematical novelty, numerical superiority or total-cost superiority hypothesis is introduced.
original_criterion_and_hypothesis.fresh_hypothesis: The configured eBPF acquisition paths may supply operation evidence sufficient for useful prospective conditional forecasts without complete SDK traces. Fresh no-agent runtime controls distinguish that feasibility from effects of collector coexistence on ancestry and application outcomes. Positive, adverse, negative and UNKNOWN findings all complete the planned scientific test.
original_criterion_and_hypothesis.causal_estimand: Within each declared application/SDK/repetition block, compare assigning none, configuredOBI, configuredCoroot or configuredDeepFlow to otherwise identical pinned deployments. The treatment includes its explicit propagation/capture/runtime configuration. This is not an intrinsic technology ranking or an assumption of passive/noninterfering observation.

complete_fresh_design.new_fixed_repetition_ids_and_coupled_see: Declare before implementation: separate deterministic random streams for fixture/payload generation, replica-state order, workload intent and treatment order. Same intended workloads within a block; record actual responses separately. Do not seed based on observed success, collector runtime duration or retry counts.

preferred_prospective_two_epoch_lifecycl.design_validity: Valid prospective prediction transferred to a fresh deployment of the same pinned blueprint; explicitly different from continuity of the original physical processes. Apply this lifecycle to every runtime arm.
preferred_prospective_two_epoch_lifecycl.training: For each block, run the four states in predeclared randomized order, one arm at a time, with fresh guests/reset persistent application state between arms. Retain complete closed training inputs, exact native/eBPF modes, images, resource declarations, logical replica roles and supplied aliases. Stop applications, collectors and guests after the closed prefix; prove owned processes/hooks cannot leak into subsequent arms.
preferred_prospective_two_epoch_lifecycl.offline_model_work: Use the exact closed training inputs only. Build actual Bering models, same-information direct/native/combined/observed-SERVER-edge-union forecasts and actual Sheaft commands where available. Freeze every model, binding and forecast before any validation targets in the block. Empty-source none/SDK-absent arms remain honestly unavailable; do not fabricate model calls.
preferred_prospective_two_epoch_lifecycl.validation: Instantiate fresh guests from the same pinned images/blueprint and declared clean fixture state. All four validation arms of the block share the validation runner and run separately in an independently randomized order. The training and validation runners may differ, with actual host/boot identities recorded. Validate replica interventions/restoration, primary operations and the separately scoped database/asynchronous outcomes using the unchanged external oracle.
preferred_prospective_two_epoch_lifecycl.forbidden_leakage: No validation outcomes, validation source observations or newly observed runtime identities may repair a frozen binding, refit its model or revise a forecast. Fresh runtime identities may verify the blueprint, identify external evidence and score frozen classification, with phase-bound provenance. Supplied logical roles are not claims of identical PID, boot or physical replica identity.
preferred_prospective_two_epoch_lifecycl.deployment_segment_count: 108 scientific cells have separate training and validation deployment segments, nominally216 fresh segments. These are not216 independent scientific repetitions. Within a runtime cell, source/view rows share outcomes; different runtime treatments have distinct fresh external outcomes even when their workload intents are coupled.
preferred_prospective_two_epoch_lifecycl.six_hour_boundary: Do not run four old complete campaigns in one six-hour job or keep live applications producing background traffic for a multi-hour model wait. Training capture, offline workers and validation capture need separately qualified bounded jobs. If the same-runner four-arm phase cannot fit, stop and review a different blocked allocation before main dispatch rather than silently changing pairing.

controls_and_treatment_definition.none_arm: A first-class no-study-eBPF-agent arm, not fakeOBI with exports discarded. Verify no selected study-agent process/guest hook; use fresh guest kernels. Keep the same native receiver and neutral external measurement infrastructure across runtime arms. No claim that the provider's physical host contains no other instrumentation.
controls_and_treatment_definition.SDK_absent_none: Verify configured application trace providers/exporters/propagators are disabled and the study eBPF agent is absent. Zero native exports alone is insufficient. Call this SDK-tracing-disabled/no-study-agent, not SDK libraries/runtime removed.
controls_and_treatment_definition.SDK_full_none: Clean native-source runtime comparator with declared enabled SDK/sampling/propagation settings; full means configured SDK coverage, not guaranteed complete exported ancestry.
controls_and_treatment_definition.SDK_partial_none: The same predeclared components, including both controlled replicas, have SDK tracing disabled; other designated SDK paths remain enabled. This no-agent arm is required, not inferred from the full-SDK control.
controls_and_treatment_definition.OBI: Declare active context_propagation=all as the main treatment if retaining M's configured agent. Do not call it passive observation. Propagation-off is a separately fixed mechanistic diagnostic configuration, not an extra arm silently replacing unfavorable primary measurements.
controls_and_treatment_definition.trace_context_truth: Predeclare a bounded, separately scoped natural/sampled/unsampled context diagnostic, with literal ingress/egress traceparent and sampler/nonrecording evidence. A missing exported parent is not automatically corruption. Do not infer header writer from cross-emitter ID matches. Diagnostic injected contexts must not become undisclosed primary model-training assistance; ordinary primary traffic retains its declared opaque request identifier policy.

strongest_reasonable_simple_baselines.equal_information: Every applicable source arm and simple comparator receives the same declared operation contracts, identity/placement facts, controlled replica inventory, initial-state blueprint and joint intervention law. None/empty-source controls do not lose that supplied semantic knowledge.
strongest_reasonable_simple_baselines.direct: Direct conditional A OR B, or independence from the controlled service, under the same nonintervened-requirements assumption. Existing .875/1 arithmetic equivalence is addressed before implementation and must remain visible.
strongest_reasonable_simple_baselines.other_baselines: Clean no-agent native observations; source-separated native/eBPF/combined views; ordinary-OTLP observed-SERVER-edge union retaining source-kind/entry/ambiguity safeguards; cheap context/tree/branch/family assignments and combinations with the same semantic information.
strongest_reasonable_simple_baselines.causal_source_of_possible_gain: New observed operation evidence may enable an externally validated model where clean native observations are incomplete. Agent-produced context, supplied aliases and manual contracts are explicit inputs/treatment effects, not automatic semantic discovery. Internal availability/ARI or a larger graph is not the outcome.
strongest_reasonable_simple_baselines.actual_external_success: Use actual prospective model/forecast identities and independent response/content/SQL/order checks with explicit primary versus persistence semantics. Missing forecasts stay UNKNOWN; model errors and runtime failures remain observations. No numerical, preparation-cost or novel-algorithm superiority is presumed.

resource_and_application_state_freeze.unintended20MiB_limit: Audit and resolve latent checkout20MiB/container limits before the v6 protocol freeze, based on engineering needs, with the same fixed application resource envelope across all collector/SDK arms. Record every changed blueprint/image. Never selectively enlarge an unfavorable arm or transfer v5OOM causes to new runs.
resource_and_application_state_freeze.qualification_required_before_main: Review exact none-mode implementation, source hashes and common phase/import semantics, then actual fresh-guest mode/closure/blueprint-transfer qualification. Demonstrate worst-size training/export/model/restore/validation memory and disk with real retained inputs and actual six-hour job budgets. Preserve complete inputs; no span/input truncation or success/accuracy gate.
resource_and_application_state_freeze.adverse_results: Once main108 is frozen, complete unsupported, adverse or runtime-degraded cases are not rerun to obtain positivity. Technical replacements require predefined acquisition/transport/mode/intervention invalidity, with original attempts retained. An application failure alone is not automatically technical invalidity.

complete_comparable_costs.new_study: Count actual fresh training and validation deployments, every control and mechanistic diagnostic, fixture/image/preparation work, source/adapter/none-mode development and qualification, all Bering/Sheaft/simple-baseline preparation, shared or empty-input reuse, checkpoint hashing/transfer/restore, workers, paging/disk, failures/early stops, CI, review, report and finite retention/closing costs.
complete_comparable_costs.historical_work: Keep old81 measurements/results and all prior failures/costs immutable and separate. Reused v5 components are disclosed prior preparation; they are not fresh v6 captures or zero-cost provenance. Keep iteration-specific and cumulative research cost scopes explicit.
complete_comparable_costs.overlap: Parent/worker intervals and any concurrent jobs are not sequential wall time; Actions elapsed is not CPU, billing or application overhead. Count genuine failed/retried work and exact shared work honestly.

verdict_boundary: The main agent remains responsible for the final frozen protocol. This is ORIGINAL full108 design GO before implementation, not implementation/source/qualification/execution GO, not success, and not approval to substitute a smaller useful demonstration. Any different main lifecycle, treatment set, scope or post-target fitting requires renewed scientific review. No job, code change, download, publication or external message was performed by this reviewer.
